stories.headline: René Germain wins national award for family forest education
stories.body: Vermont native René Germain has received the 2026 Family Forests Education Award for nearly three decades of work with the New York City Watershed Model Forest Program. Germain, the Watershed Agricultural Council and partners were recognized…

stories.headline: Conifex’s Mackenzie upgrades target drying and production bottlenecks
stories.body: Canada announced C$11 million for Conifex Timber’s Mackenzie operation on October 28. The package combines C$10 million in repayable support with C$1 million that does not require repayment.

stories.headline: Faulkner Ridge timber bids open Tuesday in Harrisburg
stories.body: The Pennsylvania Game Commission’s current Faulkner Ridge II sale offers an estimated 457,019 board feet of sawlogs and 1,760 tons of pulpwood across 211 acres in Scott Township, Wayne County.
stories.region: PENNSYLVANIA — WAYNE COUNTY / BIDS OPEN NOVEMBER 3

stories.headline: Maine logging award recognizes instructors building job skills in prison
stories.body: Scott DeMoranville and Alvin Wasson of Mountain View Correctional Facility received the 2026 Certified Logging Professional Logger of the Year award in the supervisor/contractor category, News Center Maine reported October 28.

featuredResource.title: Forest Enterprises of the Adirondacks
featuredResource.description: This illustrated book profiles the loggers and small businesses working in New York’s Adirondack forests. Its photographs and firsthand accounts show varied approaches to equipment, markets, family businesses and making a living in the woods.
